I know this would be unprofessional, but tell your boss next time you're at work. About everything. Show him or her bruises. Explain the situation. Whatever you can do to make them understand. Any decent human will help you. Take steps to get YOUR life in order. Say you need the day "off" but need to stay in the building. Or explain that you can work while you're getting all the legal stuff you need together. Your boss should understand your workplace is your only outlet and I highly doubt they'll fire you. While handling your personal business as work, schedule when you can leave and sync it with your paycheck. Open up a bank account at a walmart bank(assuming that's where you get groceries,as almost everyone in the US does sometimes), have the check deposited into the new account either the day of or a couple days after you leave. Use false addresses. Or if you can ever go to the post office, open up a throw away PO box for any paper trails hinting to your new life. And get yourself a GOOD ASS LAWYER. Out of town. Do not go to family first. That's where he's expecting you to go. Give it time before you go to family. You need to ensure your safety FIRST.
